problem: The helix-cli provides the callback surface (hlx comments post, hlx inspect) that the in-sprite Host Agent runner uses. The runner authenticates with a scoped, refreshable inspection token. Changes are needed to ensure the CLI works correctly with scoped tokens and potentially supports token refresh for long-lived sprite sessions.

files.why: Callback surface for in-sprite runner to post replies. POSTs to /api/tickets/{ticketId}/comments. Currently authenticates with broad hxi_ token. Must work with scoped, refreshable tokens.
Used by runner to fetch latest comments. Supports --helix-only and --since filters. Response includes isAgentAuthored flag.
Router for comments subcommand: dispatches to 'post' and 'list' handlers.
Router for inspect subcommand: dispatches to db, logs, api, repos handlers.
Inspect DB handler: POST /api/inspect/{repoId}/database. Subject to inspection key repo scoping (FLAW-05 fix will restrict this to ticket repos).
Inspect logs handler: POST /api/inspect/{repoId}/logs. Same repo scoping applies.
Inspect API handler: GET /api/inspect/{repoId}/api. Same repo scoping applies.
Lists available repositories for inspection. Scoped tokens will restrict the visible set.

Config loading: priority order is env vars (HELIX_API_KEY/HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN, HELIX_URL/HELIX_INSPECT_BASE_URL), then multi-token config file (~/.hlx/config.json). In-sprite runner will use env vars injected by control plane.
HTTP client (hxFetch): sets X-API-Key header for hxi_ tokens, Authorization Bearer for others. Includes X-Helix-Org-ID for org scoping. 3-attempt retry with exponential backoff. 30s timeout.
Main CLI entry point and command router. Dispatches to inspect, comments, and other subcommands.
Ticket resolution: extractTicketRef uses --ticket flag or HELIX_TICKET_ID env var. In-sprite runner will set HELIX_TICKET_ID in env.
Repository resolution: resolveRepo matches by ID or display name. Inspect commands use this to map repo names to IDs.
Pure CLI (no runtime deps, only devDeps). Build: tsc, test: tsc && node --test. No ORM/database.

facts: CLI authenticates via HELIX_API_KEY or HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN env vars (config.ts), or ~/.hlx/config.json multi-token file. hxi_ prefix tokens use X-API-Key header; others use Bearer auth (http.ts).
hlx comments post: resolves ticket via --ticket flag or HELIX_TICKET_ID env, POSTs {content: message} to /api/tickets/{ticketId}/comments. Response: {comment: {id}}.
hlx inspect db/logs/api: all require repo resolution and POST/GET to /api/inspect/{repoId}/{type}. These routes are subject to inspection key repo scoping on the server side.
No token refresh mechanism exists in the CLI. The token is read from env or config at startup and used for the session duration.
No direct host-agent or sprite references found in the CLI codebase. The CLI is agnostic to where it runs.
The CLI is a zero-dependency ESM module (Node 18+, TypeScript). No ORM or database.
HELIX_TICKET_ID env var is used by resolve-ticket.ts to determine the current ticket context. The in-sprite runner can set this at sprite launch.
hxFetch includes retry logic (3 attempts, exponential backoff with jitter) and 30s request timeout.
unknowns: Whether token refresh requires CLI changes or is purely a control-plane concern (control plane rotates HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN in the sprite's env and the CLI re-reads on next invocation).

Whether the current comment post endpoint supports a dedicated agent/system identity or if FLAW-07 fix requires a server-side change only (the CLI currently just posts content; identity is server-determined from the auth token).
Whether the CLI needs to support new auth flows for scoped tokens or if the existing hxi_ token handling is sufficient (server-side scoping is the primary change).
